items.title: Jayson Tatum misses game winner in loss to Warriors as Celtics continue on worst losing skid since 2021
items.summary: The Boston Celtics, thanks to a big defensive stand from Draymond Green late, are now on their worst losing skid in years. The Celtics fell to the Golden State Warriors 88-87 on Sunday night at the Chase Center in San Francisco. That was Boston’s fourth straight loss, too, which marked the first time that the franchise had lost four consecutive games since May 2021. They had gone a ridiculous 429 games without a four-game losing skid, which was the second-longest stretch in franchise history. The Celtics once went 468 games from 1962-68.Boston led by as many as 11 late in the third quarter, and seemed in a great spot to grab the win and limit the damage to three losses. But the Warriors slowly chipped away and got back into the game, and even took the lead on a huge Brandin Podziemski 3-pointer with about 2:30 left in the contest. That was the last points that the Warriors scored.But…

items.title: Five Two-Way Players Making Early Cases For Promotions
items.summary: Two-way contracts allow NBA teams to carry three extra players in addition to the 15 on their regular season roster. These players generally bounce back and forth between the NBA and G League, but remain under team control and can’t be poached by rival franchises. You can check out our glossary entry to learn more about two-way contracts, but here are some key points to remember: Two-way players are eligible to be active for up to 50 of their team’s 82 regular season games. If a team isn’t carrying a full 15-man standard roster, its two-way players can only be active for a combined 90 “under-15” games. Players on two-way contracts will earn $678,882 in 2026/27, half of the rookie minimum. Two-way contracts can’t be signed after March 4. Two-way players are ineligible to play in the postseason (including play-in games) unless they’re promoted to the standard 15-man roster, which can…
